Writing [42] became a beloved hobby, but as I grew older, the [43] began to fade. I started reading more books, encountering critiques online, and comparing my work to others. Self-doubt crept in, and what once felt like a creative outlet became a source of [44]. I felt I had to be “good” at writing to share it.

Whether it’s painting, playing an instrument, or any other [48], there’s an expectation to perform at a high level. When we don’t meet that standard, the joy fades, replaced by feelings of inadequacy.

questions.explanation: 根据上文的“inspired by...”，作者在iPad上开始创作，几个小时后（Hours later），顺理成章地“完成”了第一篇短篇小说。wrap up意为“圆满完成，结束”，符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(showed off)：语境句：He showed off his new car to his friends. 固定搭配：show off, show off one's skills
B(pulled over)：语境句：The police officer asked the driver to pull over. 固定搭配：pull over, pull over to the side
C(cut off)：语境句：Our electricity was cut off because we didn't pay the bill. 固定搭配：cut off, cut off the supply
D(wrapped up)：语境句：We wrapped up the meeting early today. 固定搭配：wrap up, wrap up a project

questions.explanation: 作者仅用几个小时就完成了小说，由此可见作者对此充满热情，因此写作“很快”就成了他钟爱的爱好。quickly符合逻辑递进关系。
questions.supplement:
A(slowly)：语境句：The ice slowly melted in the sun. 固定搭配：slowly but surely, move slowly
B(openly)：语境句：She spoke openly about her struggles with anxiety. 固定搭配：speak openly, openly admit
C(quickly)：语境句：He quickly adapted to the new environment. 固定搭配：act quickly, learn quickly
D(carefully)：语境句：Please read the instructions carefully before starting. 固定搭配：listen carefully, think carefully

questions.explanation: 根据上文的“inspired”、“beloved hobby”，最初写作带给作者的是“兴奋”和“热情”。随着年龄增长，加上后文提到的自我怀疑，这种“兴奋感（excitement）”开始消退。
questions.supplement:
A(hope)：语境句：Never give up hope, even in the darkest times. 固定搭配：lose hope, in the hope of
B(surprise)：语境句：To my surprise, he passed the exam easily. 固定搭配：in surprise, take sb. by surprise
C(curiosity)：语境句：Curiosity drove him to explore the mysterious cave. 固定搭配：out of curiosity, satisfy one's curiosity
D(excitement)：语境句：The children could hardly contain their excitement. 固定搭配：with excitement, generate excitement

questions.explanation: 句中“what once felt like a creative outlet became a source of...”存在前后对比。曾经是创造力的发泄口，现在由于自我怀疑和与他人比较，变成了“压力（stress）”的来源。
questions.supplement:
A(relief)：语境句：It was a huge relief to know they were safe. 固定搭配：breathe a sigh of relief, to one's relief
B(truth)：语境句：To tell you the truth, I didn't like the movie. 固定搭配：tell the truth, face the truth
C(inspiration)：语境句：Nature has always been a great source of inspiration for her. 固定搭配：draw inspiration from, a source of inspiration
D(stress)：语境句：Yoga is a great way to relieve stress. 固定搭配：under stress, relieve stress

questions.explanation: 上文描述了写作从快乐变成压力的过程，作者总结说“这种转变（shift）经常发生”。shift指态度、情况或重心的转变，契合题意。
questions.supplement:
A(shift)：语境句：There has been a significant shift in public opinion. 固定搭配：make a shift, a shift in focus
B(accident)：语境句：He was severely injured in a car accident. 固定搭配：by accident, traffic accident
C(blessing)：语境句：Having a supportive family is a true blessing. 固定搭配：a blessing in disguise, count one's blessings
D(adjustment)：语境句：It took some time to make the adjustment to living abroad. 固定搭配：make an adjustment, a minor adjustment

questions.explanation: 空后同位语解释了该词的含义：“a way to relax ourselves”（一种放松自己的方式）。escape在这里指“逃避（现实压力）、放松身心的方式”，符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(growth)：语境句：Economic growth is essential for the country's development. 固定搭配：economic growth, personal growth
B(escape)：语境句：Reading provides an escape from the pressures of daily life. 固定搭配：a narrow escape, escape from reality
C(focus)：语境句：The focus of this meeting is on improving customer service. 固定搭配：focus on, main focus
D(commitment)：语境句：Marriage requires a huge emotional commitment. 固定搭配：make a commitment, commitment to

questions.explanation: 根据后文“there’s an expectation to perform at a high level”（人们期望有高水平的表现），可知社会压力要求我们在爱好上也必须“表现优异（excel）”。
questions.supplement:
A(live)：语境句：She lived a long and happy life. 固定搭配：live up to, live a... life
B(struggle)：语境句：Many young people struggle to find a stable job. 固定搭配：struggle with, struggle to do sth.
C(excel)：语境句：He has always excelled in foreign languages. 固定搭配：excel in/at, strive to excel
D(contribute)：语境句：Everyone should contribute to protecting the environment. 固定搭配：contribute to, make a contribution

questions.explanation: 前文列举了“painting, playing an instrument”，这些都属于业余爱好或追求。pursuit在此意为“事业、消遣、爱好（常指需花时间和精力的事）”。
questions.supplement:
A(ideas)：语境句：We brainstormed some creative ideas for the project. 固定搭配：come up with an idea, exchange ideas
B(pursuits)：语境句：She enjoys outdoor pursuits like hiking and cycling. 固定搭配：leisure pursuits, in pursuit of
C(distraction)：语境句：I can't study here; there are too many distractions. 固定搭配：a distraction from, provide a distraction
D(ambition)：语境句：His ultimate ambition is to run his own business. 固定搭配：achieve one's ambition, full of ambition

questions.explanation: 前文提到经常回到写作这个爱好，后文提到“自我怀疑的时刻”，两者是让步/转折关系：“尽管（in spite of）有自我怀疑的时刻”。
questions.supplement:
A(by means of)：语境句：Thoughts are expressed by means of words. 固定搭配：by means of communication, by all means
B(with respect to)：语境句：The two groups are very similar with respect to age. 固定搭配：with respect to, in respect of
C(in spite of)：语境句：He went out in spite of the heavy rain. 固定搭配：in spite of oneself, in spite of the fact that
D(in search of)：语境句：Many people moved to the city in search of better jobs. 固定搭配：go in search of, in search of truth

questions.explanation: “the constant drive for perfection”意为“不断追求完美的动力/渴望”。drive在这里作名词，意为“强烈的愿望，驱动力”，符合由爱好变为负担的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(drive)：语境句：Her drive for success helped her overcome many obstacles. 固定搭配：drive for perfection, sex drive
B(doubt)：语境句：There is no doubt that he is the best player on the team. 固定搭配：without doubt, beyond doubt
C(supply)：语境句：The water supply has been cut off due to the storm. 固定搭配：in short supply, food supply
D(imagination)：语境句：The story captured the imagination of children everywhere. 固定搭配：beyond imagination, lack of imagination

questions.explanation: 句意：对完美的追求把写作从“热爱（passion）”变成了一项苦差事（chore）。passion与chore形成鲜明对比，呼应文章开头提到的beloved hobby。
questions.supplement:
A(story)：语境句：Grandpa told us a fascinating bedtime story. 固定搭配：tell a story, make a long story short
B(passion)：语境句：Teaching is not just a job for her; it's a passion. 固定搭配：have a passion for, pursue one's passion
C(challenge)：语境句：Climbing the mountain was a real challenge. 固定搭配：face a challenge, meet a challenge
D(possibility)：语境句：We must consider the possibility of failure. 固定搭配：a strong possibility, rule out the possibility

questions.explanation: “rob sb. of sth.”是固定搭配，意为“剥夺某人某物”。这种追求完美的思维定势“剥夺”了作者曾经在写作中找到的快乐。
questions.supplement:
A(robs)：语境句：The disease robbed him of his ability to walk. 固定搭配：rob sb. of sth., rob a bank
B(reminds)：语境句：This song reminds me of my childhood. 固定搭配：remind sb. of sth., remind sb. to do sth.
C(warns)：语境句：The doctor warned him against smoking. 固定搭配：warn sb. about/against sth., warn sb. to do sth.
D(informs)：语境句：Please inform us of any changes in your schedule. 固定搭配：inform sb. of sth., keep sb. informed

questions.explanation: 文章主旨呼吁人们接纳不完美。所以作者指出：“在某方面不优秀也是没关系的（okay）”。这与结尾的“即使你并不伟大，也要享受过程”相呼应。
questions.supplement:
A(sad)：语境句：It is sad to see so many animals losing their habitats. 固定搭配：feel sad, a sad story
B(okay)：语境句：It's perfectly okay to ask for help when you need it. 固定搭配：be okay with, make it okay
C(intolerable)：语境句：The heat in the desert was almost intolerable. 固定搭配：find sth. intolerable, an intolerable situation
D(awesome)：语境句：The view from the top of the mountain was truly awesome. 固定搭配：look awesome, an awesome experience

questions.explanation: 空后解释说“我们往往是自己最苛刻的批评者”，这说明完美是没有客观标准的，而是“主观的（subjective）”。
questions.supplement:
A(random)：语境句：The computer generates a sequence of random numbers. 固定搭配：at random, random sample
B(temporary)：语境句：These measures are only temporary and will be changed soon. 固定搭配：temporary relief, temporary job
C(subjective)：语境句：Beauty is subjective; everyone has their own preference. 固定搭配：highly subjective, a subjective judgment
D(magical)：语境句：The children had a magical time at the theme park. 固定搭配：magical powers, a magical moment

questions.explanation: 根据上文“there’s an expectation to perform at a high level”，挑战在于在“享受（enjoyment）”和“期望（expectation）”之间找到平衡。
questions.supplement:
A(joy)：语境句：The baby brought them so much joy and happiness. 固定搭配：jump for joy, tears of joy
B(overwork)：语境句：He fell ill due to stress and overwork. 固定搭配：suffer from overwork, a result of overwork
C(enthusiasm)：语境句：She showed great enthusiasm for the new project. 固定搭配：with enthusiasm, spark enthusiasm
D(expectation)：语境句：The reality did not meet my expectations. 固定搭配：beyond expectation, meet one's expectations

vocab_pack.definition_en: to fill with the urge or ability to do or feel something, often by example
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中“inspired by”是过去分词短语作状语，表示原因；inspired为过去分词，by引出施动者。
vocab_pack.example_en: The artist was inspired by nature to create her masterpiece.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位艺术家受自然启发创作了她的杰作。

vocab_pack.definition_en: cheerful and carefree
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 轻松愉快的，无忧无虑的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中作定语修饰conversation，形容对话轻松愉快。
vocab_pack.example_en: We had a lighthearted discussion about our favorite movies.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们轻松愉快地讨论了最喜欢的电影。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to finish or complete something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中“wrapped up”是过去完成时的一部分（had wrapped up），表示动作已经完成；wrap up的过去分词形式。
vocab_pack.example_en: Let's wrap up the meeting by noon.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们中午前结束会议吧。
vocab_pack.from_passage: had wrapped up my first short story

vocab_pack.definition_en: to examine similarities and differences between two things, often with 'to'
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中comparing是现在分词作状语，表示伴随动作，to引出比较对象。
vocab_pack.example_en: Don't compare your life to others'.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 不要把你的生活与别人的相比。

vocab_pack.definition_en: lack of confidence in oneself and one's abilities
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中作主语，名词单数形式，谓语crept用过去式。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her self-doubt prevented her from applying for the promotion.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的自我怀疑阻止了她申请晋升。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to enter or appear gradually and often unnoticed
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中crept是过去式，in是副词，表示动作逐渐发生。
vocab_pack.example_en: As the deadline approached, anxiety crept in.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 随着截止日期临近，焦虑悄然而至。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a means of expressing one's creative abilities
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 创造性情感表达方式，创作渠道
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中作表语，与felt like构成系表结构，outlet为可数名词单数。
vocab_pack.example_en: Photography serves as a creative outlet for many people.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 对许多人来说，摄影是一种创造性表达方式。

vocab_pack.definition_en: something that causes stress or anxiety
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中作表语，became后接名词短语，stress为不可数名词。
vocab_pack.example_en: Work is a major source of stress for many.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 工作对许多人来说是主要的压力来源。

vocab_pack.definition_en: the influence exerted by society on individuals to conform to certain standards
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中作主语，复数形式pressures，谓语can change用复数。
vocab_pack.example_en: Societal pressure often pushes young people to choose certain careers.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 社会压力常常推动年轻人选择某些职业。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be exceptionally good at or proficient in an activity or subject
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中“to excel”是不定式作定语修饰pressures，表示「要优秀的压力」。
vocab_pack.example_en: She excels in mathematics and science.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她在数学和科学方面很出色。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to do something very well, meeting high standards
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中“to perform at a high level”是不定式短语作定语修饰expectation。
vocab_pack.example_en: The athlete trained hard to perform at a high level.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 运动员刻苦训练以保持高水平表现。
vocab_pack.from_passage: expectation to perform at a high level

vocab_pack.definition_en: to reach a required level of quality or performance
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中meet是原形（don't meet），that standard作宾语，表示不达到那个标准。
vocab_pack.example_en: The product failed to meet safety standards.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该产品未能达到安全标准。

vocab_pack.definition_en: the emotional state of feeling insufficient or not good enough
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中作介词by的宾语，表示被这种感受所取代。
vocab_pack.example_en: She often struggles with feelings of inadequacy at work.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她在工作中常与不足感作斗争。

vocab_pack.definition_en: despite; without being affected by
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中引导让步状语，后接名词短语“moments of self-doubt”。
vocab_pack.example_en: He went on with his plan in spite of the obstacles.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 尽管有障碍，他还是继续他的计划。
vocab_pack.from_passage: in spite of moments of self-doubt

vocab_pack.definition_en: to attend or enroll in courses
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中taken是过去分词，构成现在完成时have taken，creative writing是定语修饰classes。
vocab_pack.example_en: I plan to take classes in photography this summer.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我计划今年夏天上摄影课。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a notable or important increase in quality or performance
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中作seen的宾语，seen significant improvement是现在完成时，improvement不可数。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new training method led to a significant improvement in scores.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新的训练方法使分数显著提高。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a strong motivation to achieve flawlessness
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中“the constant drive for perfection”作主语，drive是名词，constant作定语，for perfection介词短语修饰drive。
vocab_pack.example_en: His drive for perfection sometimes leads to burnout.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他对完美的追求有时会导致精疲力竭。

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: turns writing from a passion into a chore
vocab_pack.definition_en: to change something into something else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中turns是第三人称单数一般现在时，into是介词，宾语writing被插入中间形成“turns writing ... into a chore”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The magician turned the scarf into a rabbit.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 魔术师把围巾变成了一只兔子。
vocab_pack.from_passage: turns writing from a passion into a chore

vocab_pack.definition_en: a strong and barely controllable emotion; intense enthusiasm
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中“from a passion”中passion是名词，与介词from构成短语，表示从一种热情转为杂务。
vocab_pack.example_en: Music has always been his passion.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 音乐一直是他酷爱的事物。
vocab_pack.from_passage: from a passion into a chore

vocab_pack.definition_en: a routine or boring task
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中“into a chore”中chore是名词，与介词into构成短语，表示变成了枯燥的任务。
vocab_pack.example_en: Doing the dishes is my least favorite chore.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 洗碗是我最不喜欢的家务。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to gradually become aware of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中“I've come to realize”是现在完成时，come是过去分词，to realize是不定式，表示逐渐明白。
vocab_pack.example_en: After many years, he came to realize the importance of family.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 多年后，他逐渐意识到家庭的重要性。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a set of attitudes or beliefs that shape one's thinking
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中作主语，this mindset指代前文提到的追求完美的思维。
vocab_pack.example_en: A growth mindset helps people embrace challenges.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 成长型思维帮助人们拥抱挑战。
vocab_pack.from_passage: this mindset robs me of the joy

vocab_pack.definition_en: to deprive someone of something valuable
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中robs是第三人称单数一般现在时，me是间接宾语，of the joy是介词短语表示被剥夺的东西。
vocab_pack.example_en: The accident robbed her of her ability to walk.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 事故夺走了她的行走能力。

vocab_pack.definition_en: based on personal feelings, tastes, or opinions
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中作表语，与is构成系表结构，表示完美往往是主观的。
vocab_pack.example_en: Beauty is subjective; different people have different tastes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 美是主观的，不同的人有不同的品味。

vocab_pack.definition_en: usually; in most cases
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中作状语，修饰are，表示通常我们是自己最严格的批评者。
vocab_pack.example_en: More often than not, the best solution is the simplest one.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 通常情况下，最好的解决方案是最简单的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: more often than not, we are our toughest critics

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who is very critical and hard to please
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中用最高级toughest critics，表示我们通常是自己最严厉的批评者。
vocab_pack.example_en: My father is a tough critic when it comes to my writing.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 对于我的写作，我父亲是个严厉的批评者。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to achieve a desirable equilibrium between two things
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中finding是动名词作主语，the balance是宾语，between enjoyment and expectation是介词短语修饰balance。
vocab_pack.example_en: It's important to find a balance between work and rest.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在工作和休息之间找到平衡很重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: finding the balance between enjoyment and expectation

vocab_pack.definition_en: to accept or welcome something willingly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中“Embrace imperfection”是祈使句，动词原形开头，表示建议。
vocab_pack.example_en: We should embrace change as an opportunity.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们应该把变化当作机会来拥抱。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to take pleasure in the steps or journey rather than the outcome
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中“enjoy the process”是祈使句，动词原形，process是名词。
vocab_pack.example_en: Don't just focus on the result; learn to enjoy the process.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 不要只关注结果，要学会享受过程。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be very skilled or proficient at something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句中“are great at”是系表结构，引号表示反语或强调；此处提取了“great at”。
vocab_pack.example_en: She is great at solving puzzles.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她非常擅长解谜题。

section_2_word_form.passage:
Food plays a significant role in classic Chinese novels, with one of the most famous examples being Cao Xueqin’s Dream of the Red Chamber. In this 18th-century novel, food is a key part of the story, revealing details about characters [56] advancing the plot. The book’s most famous dish, a [57] (prepare) of eggplant called qiexiang (茄鲞), is a rich dish that requires [58] (day) to prepare, involving steaming eggplant ten times in soup made from old hens. The dish overwhelms the family’s poor relatives, first with envy, and later, with terrible discomfort in stomachs.
The novel provides ample inspiration for today’s cooks. Food bloggers go viral with attempts [59] (recreate) the book’s most famous dishes. “Red Chamber Banquets” pop up in theme restaurants across China, and indeed worldwide, with the dishes plated in Michelin style.
While most foods [60] (serve) in the novel are made with high skill, they are made with only a few simple seasonal ingredients. In China’s culinary culture, humble ingredients [61] (prize) because they are in season. A relative [62] brags (吹嘘) about enjoying food out of season is later revealed to have a dangerously violent temper. “A bad apple,” one might say.
Like all great literature, the enduring popularity of Dream of the Red Chamber comes from [63] (it) many layers of meanings. Readers can appreciate it more than [64] an engaging story. The same can also be said about the food. When we read about it, we can admire the cooking art, mine [65] text for historical clues, or seek double meanings in every “bite”.

questions.explanation: 设空处连接两个并列的现在分词短语“revealing details...”和“advancing the plot”，表示并列关系，应填连词and。
questions.supplement: 正确形(and)：语境句：She sat by the window, reading a book and sipping coffee. 固定搭配：and so on, both... and...。原词其它变形：无

questions.explanation: 空前有不定冠词a，此处需要填入名词形式，表示“一种用茄子制作的菜肴/制法”，填preparation。
questions.supplement: 正确形(preparation)：语境句：Thorough preparation is the key to passing the exam. 固定搭配：in preparation for, food preparation。原词prepare其它变形：prepared(adj.), preparatory(adj.)

questions.explanation: 根据常识和语境（蒸十次），这道菜需要花费“数天”时间来准备，day是可数名词，此处需用复数形式days。
questions.supplement: 正确形(days)：语境句：It took us several days to finish the project. 固定搭配：these days, early days。原词day其它变形：daily(adj./adv.)

questions.explanation: attempt后常接动词不定式作后置定语，即attempt to do sth.（尝试做某事）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to recreate)：语境句：The artist attempted to recreate the beauty of the landscape. 固定搭配：attempt to do sth., make an attempt to do。原词recreate其它变形：recreation(n.)

questions.explanation: 分析句子结构可知，are made是谓语动词，空处需用非谓语动词作定语修饰foods。food与serve之间是逻辑被动关系，故用过去分词served。
questions.supplement: 正确形(served)：语境句：The dishes served at the banquet were absolutely delicious. 固定搭配：be served with, serve as。原词serve其它变形：service(n.), servant(n.)

questions.explanation: 此处陈述中国饮食文化中的客观事实，应用一般现在时；主语ingredients为复数，且与prize（珍视）构成被动关系，故填are prized。
questions.supplement: 正确形(are prized)：语境句：In this company, hard work and creativity are highly prized. 固定搭配：prize sth. highly, be prized for。原词prize其它变形：prizewinner(n.)

questions.explanation: 引导定语从句修饰先行词A relative（人），且在从句中作主语，故填who或that。
questions.supplement: 正确形(who/that)：语境句：The teacher who/that helped me the most is Mrs. Smith. 固定搭配：those who, anyone who。原词其它变形：无

questions.explanation: 空后为名词短语many layers of meanings，此处需要形容词性物主代词修饰名词，指代《红楼梦》这本小说的，填its。
questions.supplement: 正确形(its)：语境句：The dog wagged its tail happily when the owner returned. 固定搭配：its own, at its best。原词it其它变形：itself(pron.)

questions.explanation: 句意：读者可以将它视为“不仅仅是（more than just）”一个引人入胜的故事。填just构成常见强调搭配；也可填as，构成appreciate sth. as sth.（把...欣赏/视为...），“as more than”同样符合语法逻辑。历年高考标准答案多倾向于just或merely。
questions.supplement: 正确形(just)：语境句：This is more than just a job; it's a calling. 固定搭配：more than just, just about。正确形(as)：语境句：I appreciate his effort as a genuine attempt to help. 固定搭配：appreciate... as...。原词其它变形：无

questions.explanation: 此处特指《红楼梦》这部小说的文本，故需要用定冠词the进行特指。
questions.supplement: 正确形(the)：语境句：Please read the text on page 42 carefully. 固定搭配：the text, the same。原词其它变形：无

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have an important part or influence
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 扮演重要角色；起重要作用
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 短语在句中作谓语，一般现在时，主语为第三人称单数（Food），故谓语用 plays。
vocab_pack.example_en: Education plays a significant role in the development of a nation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 教育在国家发展中起着重要作用。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Food plays a significant role in classic Chinese novels

vocab_pack.term: one of the most famous examples
vocab_pack.form_in_passage: one of the most famous examples
vocab_pack.definition_en: a member of a group that is very well known
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 作介词 with 的宾语，构成 with 复合结构。one of 后的名词必须用复数（examples），且该短语为固定搭配。
vocab_pack.example_en: Shakespeare's Hamlet is one of the most famous examples of tragic drama.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 莎士比亚的《哈姆雷特》是最著名的悲剧典范之一。
vocab_pack.from_passage: with one of the most famous examples being Cao Xueqin’s Dream of the Red Chamber

vocab_pack.definition_en: an essential or crucial component
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作表语（is a key part），前面有不定冠词 a，key 为形容词修饰 part。
vocab_pack.example_en: Teamwork is a key part of successful project management.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 团队合作是成功项目管理的关键部分。
vocab_pack.from_passage: food is a key part of the story

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make known specific information concerning something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为现在分词短语（revealing…）作伴随状语，与主语 food 构成主动关系。原形 reveal 常接 details about。
vocab_pack.example_en: The investigation revealed crucial details about the accident.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 调查揭示了事故的关键细节。
vocab_pack.from_passage: revealing details about characters and advancing the plot

vocab_pack.definition_en: to move the storyline forward
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 与 revealing 并列，同为现在分词短语作伴随状语，主动语态。advance 在此为及物动词。
vocab_pack.example_en: The unexpected twist advanced the plot in a surprising direction.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 出人意料的转折将情节推向了一个令人惊讶的方向。

vocab_pack.definition_en: the act or process of making something ready; a dish that has been prepared
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作主语补足语 (a preparation of eggplant)，是可数名词单数，前有不定冠词 a。此处指一种精心制作的菜肴。
vocab_pack.example_en: The chef’s special preparation of mushrooms took three hours.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 厨师特制的蘑菇菜肴花了三个小时。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a preparation (prepare) of eggplant called qiexiang

vocab_pack.definition_en: to need a specified amount of time in order to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 require 为及物动词，一般现在时，主语为单数（the dish），故用 requires。days 为名词复数作宾语，to prepare 为不定式作目的状语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Building a skyscraper requires years to complete.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 建造一座摩天大楼需要数年的时间才能完成。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to include or entail an activity as a necessary part
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 包括做某事；涉及做某事
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 involving 为现在分词短语作状语，进一步说明做法。原形 involve 后接动名词作宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The project involves conducting extensive research.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该项目需要进行广泛的研究。

vocab_pack.definition_en: produced by using a certain material that undergoes transformation
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 由……制成（原料发生化学或物理变化）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 made from 为过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 soup，表示汤由老母鸡制成。被动含义。
vocab_pack.example_en: This wine is made from the finest grapes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这种酒是用最好的葡萄酿造的。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause someone to experience a strong emotion (e.g., envy, joy) in an overpowering way
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 使某人因……而情绪失控；以……压倒某人
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 overwhelm 为及物动词，一般现在时，主语为 the dish，单数第三人称，故用 overwhelms。with envy 表示原因。
vocab_pack.example_en: The kindness of strangers overwhelmed her with gratitude.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 陌生人的善意让她感激不已。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The dish overwhelms the family’s poor relatives, first with envy

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become extremely popular and widely shared quickly on the internet
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作谓语，一般现在时，主语为复数（bloggers），动词用原形 go。viral 为形容词作表语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The video of the cat went viral overnight.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那只猫的视频一夜之间火了起来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Food bloggers go viral with attempts to recreate

vocab_pack.definition_en: an effort or try to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 attempts 为名词复数，作介词 with 的宾语，后接不定式 to recreate 作定语。
vocab_pack.example_en: His attempts to climb the mountain failed due to bad weather.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他攀登那座山的尝试因天气恶劣而失败。
vocab_pack.from_passage: attempts to recreate the book’s most famous dishes

vocab_pack.definition_en: to appear suddenly or unexpectedly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作谓语，一般现在时，主语为复数（banquets），故用原形 pop up。
vocab_pack.example_en: New cafes pop up in this neighborhood every month.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个街区每个月都有新咖啡馆突然冒出来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: “Red Chamber Banquets” pop up in theme restaurants across China

vocab_pack.definition_en: to arrange (food) on a plate for serving, especially in an artistic way
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 plated 为过去分词，构成 with＋宾语＋过去分词的独立主格结构（with the dishes plated），表示被动和完成意义。
vocab_pack.example_en: The chef carefully plates each dish before serving.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 上菜前，厨师精心摆好每一道菜。
vocab_pack.from_passage: with the dishes plated in Michelin style

vocab_pack.definition_en: to provide (food or drinks) for people to eat
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 served 为过去分词作后置定语，修饰 foods，表示被动（被供应的食物）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The restaurant serves traditional Chinese cuisine.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家餐厅供应传统中餐。
vocab_pack.from_passage: most foods served (serve) in the novel

vocab_pack.definition_en: food items that are available and at their best during a particular time of year
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作介词 with 的宾语，与 a few simple 构成名词短语。seasonal 为形容词修饰 ingredients。
vocab_pack.example_en: Using seasonal ingredients ensures the freshest flavor.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 使用应季食材能确保最鲜美的味道。
vocab_pack.from_passage: made with only a few simple seasonal ingredients

vocab_pack.definition_en: simple, plain, or inexpensive food items
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 朴素的食材；不起眼的食材
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作主语（humble ingredients），humble 为形容词修饰主语，谓语用 are prized。
vocab_pack.example_en: Humble ingredients like potatoes and onions can create delicious dishes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 土豆和洋葱等朴素的食材也能做出美味的菜肴。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to value something highly; to treasure
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 prized 为过去分词，与 are 构成被动语态（are prized），表示“被珍视”。主语为 humble ingredients。
vocab_pack.example_en: In many cultures, handcrafted items are prized for their uniqueness.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在许多文化中，手工制品因其独特性而受到珍视。

vocab_pack.definition_en: (of a food product) available and at its peak quality during a particular period
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作表语（are in season），与 because 从句连用，说明原因。
vocab_pack.example_en: Strawberries are in season from May to July.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 草莓在五月到七月当季。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to talk too proudly about something you have or have done
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在定语从句中作谓语，关系代词 who 指代 a relative，第三人称单数，故用 brags。about 为介词。
vocab_pack.example_en: He always brags about his high test scores.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他总是吹嘘自己的高分。
vocab_pack.from_passage: A relative who / that brags (吹嘘) about enjoying food out of season

vocab_pack.definition_en: (of a food product) not available or not at its best quality during a certain time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作状语（enjoying food out of season），修饰动名词 enjoying。
vocab_pack.example_en: Eating strawberries out of season often means they are tasteless.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 吃反季的草莓通常意味着它们没什么味道。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be discovered or made known to possess a certain quality or thing
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为被动语态（is revealed），主语 a relative，后用不定式 to have 作主语补足语。later 为时间状语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The politician was revealed to have accepted bribes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位政客被揭露收受贿赂。
vocab_pack.from_passage: is later revealed to have a dangerously violent temper

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a particular mood or tendency to become angry
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在不定式短语中（to have a... temper），have 为原形，a dangerously violent 修饰 temper。
vocab_pack.example_en: She has a quick temper and often regrets it.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她脾气急躁，常常事后后悔。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to have a dangerously violent temper

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who causes problems or is a bad influence within a group
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在直接引语中作表语，前面有引号，表示比喻义。
vocab_pack.example_en: In any team, there is always one bad apple that spoils the rest.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在任何团队中，总有一个害群之马影响其他人。

vocab_pack.definition_en: continuing and long-lasting fame or approval
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 持久的受欢迎度；经久不衰的声望
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作主语（the enduring popularity），enduring 为形容词修饰 popularity。
vocab_pack.example_en: The enduring popularity of classical music is remarkable.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 古典音乐经久不衰的受欢迎度令人惊叹。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the enduring popularity of Dream of the Red Chamber

vocab_pack.definition_en: to originate from or be derived from a source
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作谓语，一般现在时，主语为 popularity，单数第三人称，故用 comes。
vocab_pack.example_en: Much of our knowledge comes from reading.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们的很多知识来自阅读。
vocab_pack.from_passage: comes from its (it) many layers of meanings

vocab_pack.definition_en: multiple levels or depths of significance
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为介词宾语（from its many layers of meanings），layers 为名词复数，of meanings 为后置定语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Great poetry often contains layers of meaning that reveal themselves over time.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 伟大的诗歌往往含有层层含义，随着时间的推移逐渐显现。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to recognize the value or quality of something by considering it in a certain way
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中结构为 appreciate it as an engaging story（原文中可能选择 as），但此处取该搭配。appreciate 为及物动词，it 为宾语，as 引导宾语补足语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many people appreciate classical music as a form of relaxation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多人把古典音乐作为一种放松方式来欣赏。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Readers can appreciate it more than just / as an engaging story

vocab_pack.definition_en: to search carefully through something (e.g., a text) in order to extract useful information
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作谓语，与 can 连用（can mine），the text 为宾语，for historical clues 表示目的。mine 为动词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: Historians mine old documents for clues about daily life.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 历史学家从旧文件中挖掘关于日常生活的线索。
vocab_pack.from_passage: mine the text for historical clues

vocab_pack.definition_en: to look for two or more interpretations (often a literal and a hidden one)
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 寻找双关含义；寻求双重意义
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中与 can 连用（can seek），seek 为及物动词原形，double meanings 为宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: In satire, readers often seek double meanings behind the humor.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在讽刺作品中，读者常常在幽默背后寻找双重含义。

vocab_pack.definition_en: each mouthful or small piece of food
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作介词 in 的宾语，bite 用引号可能指双关（食物/品味）。every 为限定词。
vocab_pack.example_en: She savored every bite of the delicious meal.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她细细品味了这顿美味佳肴的每一口。

vocab_pack.definition_en: more than enough creative stimulation or ideas
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作宾语（provides ample inspiration），ample 为形容词修饰不可数名词 inspiration。
vocab_pack.example_en: Nature provides ample inspiration for artists.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 大自然为艺术家提供了充足的灵感。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The novel provides ample inspiration for today’s cooks.
